The shelf is filled with various items, including books, a small stuffed animal resembling a dog, a few watches, and some other miscellaneous objects. On top of the shelf, there is a green plastic bottle of water and a can. The wall above the shelf has four framed pictures or posters arranged in a square pattern. The posters appear to be artistic or abstract in nature, featuring geometric shapes and vibrant colors.
